truncate.name: exactly_limit

truncate.name: cyrillic_cut

truncate.name: cyrillic_exact
truncate.why: cut exactly at the code-point boundary

truncate.name: emoji_cut
truncate.why: cutting inside a ZWJ sequence: code-point cut, not grapheme

truncate.name: real_message_limit
truncate.why: the production limit applied to a long Cyrillic text

chunks.name: single_exact
chunks.why: length equals chunk size: still one chunk

chunks.name: emoji_boundary
chunks.why: ZWJ sequence split across chunks by code point

chunks.name: empty
chunks.why: empty input yields one empty chunk

chunks.name: real_graph_limit
chunks.why: the production limit on a long Cyrillic text
